objective: For G = N x| C_r with N a p-group that is a central extension of elementary abelian groups with an equivariant bilinear cocycle and p not dividing r: if the commutator pairing vanishes on every pair of eigencharacters chi, chi' with chi, chi' and chi chi' nontrivial, then counting homomorphisms from closed 3-manifold groups with bounded first homology is polynomial (enumerate the bounded trivial-character part, then linear conditions and a bounded number of quadratic conditions, counted by Gauss sums). Check against brute force.
status: Proved by COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001C-P001: for G = N x| C_r with N a p-group built from elementary abelian layers by an equivariant bilinear cocycle and p not dividing r, if no pair of eigencharacters chi, chi' with chi, chi' and chi chi' nontrivial carries a nonzero commutator pairing, then counting homomorphisms is polynomial for closed 3-manifolds with bounded first homology (and for knot groups): enumerate the bounded trivial-character part, then affine conditions and a bounded number of quadratic conditions counted by Gauss sums. Checked against enumeration in 56 cases and brute force in eight.
title: Without a hard pair, counting is polynomial with bounded homology
